readinessDefinitions.historicalFinancialAnalysisReady: At least two qualified reporting periods with CORE and SECTOR_CORE complete, evaluated for current analysis; does not authorize historical point-in-time use.
readinessDefinitions.currentFinancialDataReady: Latest selected qualified period has complete CORE and SECTOR_CORE and CURRENT reporting-cycle freshness.

extractionMethod: All retained PDFs reparsed for validity; qualification and reviewed source cells rebound to fresh retained hashes and canonicalized. New unreviewed OCR facts are not admitted.
